'''Revenant werewolves''' are a type of monster, that inhabits the [[Forinthry Dungeon]], along with all other [[revenants]].
The Forinthry Dungeon is a part of the [[Wilderness]] so it is possible to be attacked by other players here if opted into [[PvP]].

Like all revenants, they can restore lifepoints quickly, can cure themselves of poison and react quickly to a player's protection prayers. When below 50% health, revenant werewolves will "eat" to heal 950 lifepoints from their limited supply of food. For a full description of the healing mechanic see the [[Revenants#Overview|revenants]] page.

==Drops==
{{DropLogProject|jagex=yes}}

Revenant drops are not affected by [[luck]]. There are only two ways to increase the drop rate of revenant items: completion of the [[elite Wilderness achievements]] which gives a 5% increased chance for revenant drops, and [[revenant drop enhancer]]s, which give a 10% increased chance. Both boosts can be in effect at the same time.
